name: Playa del Carmen
tagline: Caribbean beach town between cenotes and Mayan ruins
summary: Playa del Carmen is the lively heart of the Riviera Maya: white sand, the pedestrian Quinta Avenida and ferries to Cozumel's reefs. It's an easy base for cenotes, eco-parks and the ruins of Tulum and Cobá.
seasonNote: December to April is dry and busy. June to November is hurricane season; sargassum seaweed can affect beaches in summer.
arrival: About 50 minutes from Cancún Airport by ADO bus or shuttle.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; colectivo vans along the highway; ferry to Cozumel.
cashTip: Carry pesos for taxis, tacos and markets; cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants. Pay in pesos, not dollars, for a better rate.
foodTip: Cochinita pibil, tacos al pastor and fresh ceviche.
baseArea: Near Quinta Avenida, a few blocks back from the beach
